title: Native macOS: menu bar, dark mode, shortcuts, dialogs, dock, window state
description: Implement native macOS features: menu bar (File: New Project, Open Brief, Settings, Quit; Edit: standard; View: Toggle Panel, Toggle Dark Mode; Window: standard; Help), dark mode following system appearance, keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+Enter send, Y/N approve, Cmd+\ panel, Cmd+, settings, Cmd+N new project), native dialogs (folder picker, file picker, confirm), dock icon, window state persistence (size, position, panel state) via UserDefaults or plist.
acceptance_criteria: Menu bar: File (New Project, Open Brief, Settings, Quit), Edit (standard), View (Toggle Panel, Toggle Dark Mode), Window (standard), Help
Dark mode: follows system appearance, toggle in View menu
Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd+Enter send, Y/N approve, Cmd+\ panel, Cmd+, settings, Cmd+N new project
Native dialogs: folder picker, file picker, confirm dialog all use native macOS dialogs
Dock icon: app has a dock icon, clicking it focuses the window
Window state: size, position, panel state persisted across app restarts
